lines.text: The night he didn't come home.
lines.show: The night he didn't come home.

lines.text: [low, certain] A mechanical watch doesn't stop by itself. Someone has to stop winding it.
[after a while, very quietly] Eleven eleven. Three years ago. The night he didn't come home.
lines.show: 11:11. Three years ago. The night he didn't come home.

lines.text: [at the gate, easy and warm] Get home safe.
[quiet] He said it like it was the easiest thing in the world.
